name: dgpu_soc_v2_realip_p2
description: dGPU SoC Phase C 4-IP nested topology (per openspec/changes/dgpu-realip-pin-contract archived 2026-10-09: T23B + T25A.1 + T25B + T26 facade dormant-guard). 4-IP topology: PcieControllerIP + GpuInternalFabric + VramControllerTLM + PcieEndpointIP (3 direct children under DGpuSoc, 4th via PcieEndpointIP composite). 4 routing_enabled 字段保留 (per ADR-DGPU-10 anti-hijack root cause 4 + Change C.4 REVISED `f66070a8` 终态) — 与 minimal_v1/timing_v1 字段对齐. 嵌套结构: GpuInternalFabric 节点内含 CrossbarTLM child (T25A.1: simulate_instantiate 覆写遍历调 attach_crossbar). VramControllerTLM params 镜像 timing-mode 模板 (per cpptlm-dgpu-soc-timing-mvp), MUST NOT 1 lock. PcieAxiBridgeIP 不在 children (MUST NOT 2 lock, per Oracle bg_c60653e0 §4). MUST NOT 1/2/3 grep-gate check_pcie_ip_facade.sh enforces. 23 ABI 签名零 diff (per ADR-DGPU-08 frozen). 4 frozen headers 零 diff (per E.1 AC-E1-1.5). **v1.1 修订**: + `flr_enabled: true` + `resizable_bars_enabled: true` 顶层配置开关 (per cpptlm-pcie-host-test-flr-rebar v1.1 Phase 5.3). + `soc_noc.data_flow: true` 节点占位 (per cpptlm-dgpu-soc-internal-noc-e1 v1.1 DataNoC, but 实际装配由 DGpuBoard::bind_memory_backings() 动态注入, 不在此 JSON). 0 改动 PcieAxiBridgeIP 锁定 (MUST NOT 2 lock 保留).

soc_noc._note: Per e1 v1.1 DataNoC only: soc_noc 节点作为配置开关占位, SocInternalNoc 实际装配由 DGpuBoard::bind_memory_backings() 动态注入 (per E0 precedent). DataNoC only 承载 SDMA bulk DMA 流量 (per Real-IP 调研 + Oracle 复审); PT_BASE / doorbell / page walk 走独立通道 deferred to E.2 (ArchForge).

_note: Per T2 (Oracle bg_fb84a648): MUST NOT contain 'axi_adapter' or 'axi4_mapper_inject' keys in PcieControllerIP params — would double-attach via PcieEndpointIP::attach_composition auto-flow. grep-gate check_pcie_ip_facade.sh enforces this. Per T23A (Phase B P3 Amendment 2026-10-07): PcieAxiBridgeIP module entry REMOVED from JSON (PcieAxiBridgeIP REMOVED from REGISTER_MODULE per Oracle bg_c60653e0 §4 — JSON 顶层不可实例化; class 仍保留为 EP composite lazy_init 依赖). Per T23B (Phase C 2026-10-07): JSON 重建为 DGpuSoc 嵌套, 4-IP topology: PcieControllerIP + GpuInternalFabric + VramControllerTLM (3 direct children under DGpuSoc). VramControllerTLM params 镜像 timing-mode 模板 (per cpptlm-dgpu-soc-timing-mvp), MUST NOT 1 lock: VramControllerTLM 类不动, 仅 JSON 引用 + 后续 T23C backing 注入. PcieAxiBridgeIP 不在 children 中 (MUST NOT 2 lock). Per T25A.1 (Phase C 2026-10-07): GpuInternalFabric 节点加 inner CrossbarTLM child (modules/name=crossbar), GpuInternalFabric::simulate_instantiate 覆写遍历 children 调 attach_crossbar. Per Oracle bg_c60653e0 §3.4: inner crossbar MUST instantiate via ModuleFactory JSON child path (NOT raw `new`), 保证 Step 7 StreamAdapter 注入不会跳过. **v1.1 修订新增**: `flr_enabled: true` 触发 HostPcieTestStub::trigger_flr() → 既有 `PcieEndpointIP::flr_pf()` (per pcie_endpoint_ip.hh:201-202); `resizable_bars_enabled: true` 触发 HostPcieTestStub::trigger_resize_bar() → 既有 `enable_resizable_bar() + on_bar_resize()` (per pcie_endpoint_ip.cc:670-694). 0 新增 ABI 函数族 (per ADR-DGPU-08 §2.3). 0 新增 `cpptlm_emulator_flr.h` / `cpptlm_emulator_resizable_bar.h` 头文件.

resizable_bars._note: v1.1 修订: 复用既有 ResizableBar 数据结构 (per pcie_endpoint_ip.hh:321 resizable_bars_[6] array). new_size_bytes_ 字段类型 uint32→uint64 (per CRITICAL C3: 4GB 溢出). 启用 runtime resize 协议 (per flr-rebar v1.1 ResizableBarRuntime::commit()).
